items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 蒙德城的迪卢克，应约而来。闲聊恕不奉陪，如果你是想做一番大事，我倒有点兴致。
items.text_en: Diluc, of Mondstadt. Not interested in idle chit-chat. If you have things you want to get done, let me know.

items.title: 闲聊·放松
items.text: 偶尔悠闲一下，也不错。
items.text_en: Guess we can rest a bit.

items.title: 闲聊·骑士团
items.text: 应该换骑士团的那些家伙来陪你。
items.text_en: You should really bring the Knights of Favonius with you next time.

items.title: 闲聊·行会
items.text: 行会里还有很多事，你要么在这休息，我回去看看。
items.text_en: I still have a lot to do at the Guild. How about you take a rest while I go back?

items.title: 闲聊·准备
items.text: 提前做好准备，先于对方进攻吧。
items.text_en: We should prepare while we can, then make a preemptive strike against the enemy.

items.title: 闲聊·计划
items.text: 休息时，也可以思考接下来的计划。
items.text_en: Let's take a moment to rest and plan our next move.

items.title: 闲聊·提醒
items.text: 任何行动难免都有风险，你要多加小心。
items.text_en: Every course of action has its risks. Be careful.

items.title: 下雨的时候·伞
items.text: 我不用伞，你随意。
items.text_en: I don't need an umbrella, but you can use one if you need.

items.title: 下雨的时候·清洗
items.text: 雨吗，可惜洗刷不了那些污秽的心。
items.text_en: Rain... If only it could cleanse the corrupt souls of this world.

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 只要坚信自己的道路，就无所谓天气是晴是雨。
items.text_en: Listen, as long as you stick to your own path, it doesn't matter what Mother Nature throws at you.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 呼啸的风声，会被用来遮掩犯罪的痕迹。
items.text_en: Some use the wind's whistling to drown out the sound of their crimes.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 寒暄就免了。昨夜一切平安就好。
items.text_en: No need for small talk. All that matters is that you were safe last night.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 想试试隐藏菜单吗？
items.text_en: Would you like to try the secret menu?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 夜晚到了。
items.text_en: Night has fallen.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 嗯，下次见。我会目送你安全离开的。
items.text_en: Alright, see you next time. I'll make sure you leave safely.

items.title: 关于迪卢克自己
items.text: 「暗夜英雄」的传说吗？有趣的传言。
items.text_en: The legend of the "Darknight Hero"? An interesting rumor.

items.title: 关于我们·需要
items.text: 需要什么就直说。报销问题找埃泽。
items.text_en: Just say the word if you need anything. For reimbursements, ask Elzer.

items.title: 关于我们·证明
items.text: 你已经证明了你的决心。那么，也让你见证一下我的意志吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6You have already proven your determination. Well then, it is now time for you to witness my resolve.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 对于无法看清眼前道路的人来说，「神之眼」或许是神的一盏明灯。但对于有信念的人来说，只是一个可有可无的奖章罢了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Visions are a light in the sea of darkness that surrounds those who have lost their way. But for those who have faith, they are little more than badges of conviction.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 我偶尔会去「天使的馈赠」亲自调酒，因为酒馆是情报集中流通的地方。
items.text_en: Occasionally I'll work the bar at Angel's Share. The tavern is known for being the center of information in Mondstadt.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: …是夜枭。在黑暗中守望、观察的猛禽，只在最合适的时机出手，没有任何破绽。
items.text_en: What? Why do you ask? ...It's an owl, quietly watching its prey from the darkness, waiting for the perfect moment to strike... Flawless.

items.title: 关于凯亚
items.text: 凯亚吗…那个男人说的话，只能信一半。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Kaeya? You can only trust half of what he says... at best.

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 丽莎，能成为骑士团内最值得仰赖的人之一。如果她愿意的话。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I believe Lisa has the potential to become the most reliable of the knights. If she's willing.

items.title: 关于琴·敌人
items.text: 无意义的琐事，是琴最大的敌人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Trifling matters can become Jean's greatest enemy.

items.title: 关于琴·职责
items.text: 琴那无人能及的责任心，终究让她没能看清自己真正的职责啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Her unparalleled sense of responsibility is the sole reason why she still hasn't found her true calling.

items.title: 关于莫娜
items.text: 蒙德的土地浸润着风神的恩泽，就不需要赞助占星术士来预测收成了吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The land of Mondstadt, by the Anemo Archon's grace, is bountiful. I see no need for the harvest forecasts of astrologers.

items.title: 关于迪奥娜
items.text: 迪奥娜对我的态度很是生硬，我也一直没找到合适的机会交流。如果是涉及到家族恩怨的话…嗯？不是？只是单纯地讨厌酒？没想到在这蒙德，也会有讨厌酒的酒保啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Diona's attitude towards me is... how should I put it? Rather rigid. I've yet to find the opportunity to speak with her properly. I'm not sure if its an issue with my family line or— Oh? It's not? She simply despises alcohol? Huh... I never thought I'd come across another bartender like myself in Mondstadt.

items.title: 关于法尔伽
items.text: 大团长法尔伽，我能理解他的立场，却无法认同他的做派。呵…是我多言了。我早已不是西风骑士，忘了我说的话吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Grand Master Varka... While I understand his disposition, I can make no sense of his actions. ...I—I've said too much already. I've long since left the Knights of Favonius. Forget I said anything.

items.title: 关于优菈
items.text: 我听说过她，她有自己的理念。努力挣脱家族束缚的气势也值得称道。但她…却加入了西风骑士团。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ah, yes... I've heard about her. She has her own convictions. Her determination to liberate herself from the shackles of her clan is praiseworthy. But, she's... joined the Knights of Favonius.

items.title: 想要了解迪卢克·其一
items.text: 有何贵干？
items.text_en: You have business to attend to?

items.title: 想要了解迪卢克·其二
items.text: 嗯，你问骑士团？哼…没什么可多谈的，道路不同罢了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Huh? Knights of Favonius? ...I have nothing to say about them. We have different views is all.

items.title: 想要了解迪卢克·其三
items.text: 很久不和管家之外的人对弈了。难得有这份闲暇，跟我下局棋吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4It's been a long while since I played chess with anyone but my butler. I just so happen to have a moment. Care to play a round?

items.title: 想要了解迪卢克·其四
items.text: 将军。哼，但能把我逼到这个地步，还真是不简单啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Checkmate! ...Still, it's been a while since someone tested me this much.

items.title: 想要了解迪卢克·其五
items.text: 你还不赖。无论是对弈还是战斗，都不乏让人眼前一亮的表现。不…这样的合作，对我来说也算新奇…那么，今后也同行吧，「吾友」。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Not bad. Be it chess or combat, you always seem to surprise me. Hm, working with you is quite the novelty. So... I look forward to continuing to work with you, partner.

items.title: 迪卢克的爱好
items.text: 庄园里的那些艺术品？那不是我的。是先父有收集的爱好。
items.text_en: The artwork in the manor? It's not mine. It's a collection that belonged to my late father.

items.title: 迪卢克的烦恼
items.text: 真正应当消灭的敌人，孕育罪恶的「黑暗」本身，需要用刀剑以外的方法去斩断…
items.text_en: The darkness that seethes with evil, full of demons that must be vanquished, will take more than a blade to be torn asunder.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 你问我杯子里的是什么酒？葡萄汁而已，我一般喝这个。
items.text_en: You want to know what's in my glass? It's... grape juice. My drink of choice.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 我不喜欢酒。没什么…我不喜欢酒的口感。
items.text_en: I don't like alcohol. It's just... I don't like how it feels in my mouth...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 很精致。风味令人难忘。
items.text_en: Exquisite. Unforgettable flavors.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 能品尝出厨师的专注。不错的菜肴。
items.text_en: I can see the chef put their heart into this one. A fine dish.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: …谢谢。
items.text_en: ...Thanks

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐，这是属于你的重要日子。说吧，你的心愿。如果在我能力范围之内，我会考虑的。
items.text_en: Happy birthday. This is an important day for you. So tell me, what is it you wish for? If it is within my power to bestow it upon you, I will give it my consideration.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 为了达成目标，力量是必须的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Power is necessary if we are to meet our objectives.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 前方会有什么？我很少会思考这种问题。我必须前进，不论有谁阻挡在我面前。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2What lies in wait for us? I rarely stop to think about it. No matter what dares to stand in my way, I must press forward.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 力量增强了…虽然还不够，但终归是在向前方探索。在「黎明」到来之前，必须有人稍微照亮「黑暗」…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4I've become stronger... Though it is still not enough, I will always face the darkness. For dawn to come, there must be those who dare to pierce the darkness with their light.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 我原以为——要扫荡罪恶的话，我必须独自行走在长夜之中。但你的坚持让我意识到，我又一次错了。「同伴」，我向你致以感谢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6I used to believe... if I was to stamp out evil, I would have to walk alone in darkness. However, seeing your perseverance, I know I was wrong. Friend... I owe you my thanks.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 呵。
items.text_en: Hmph.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 哈。
items.text_en: Hah!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text_en: Haah!——

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.title_en: Elemental Skill: I (Red Dead of Night Outfit)
items.text: 呵。
items.text_en: Huh!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.title_en: Elemental Skill: II (Red Dead of Night Outfit)
items.text: 哈。
items.text_en: Hyah!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.title_en: Elemental Skill: III (Red Dead of Night Outfit)
items.text_en: Haah!—

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 在此——宣判！
items.text_en: Your verdict is...!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 火焰——烧尽。
items.text_en: Burn!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 审判——喝啊！
items.text_en: Time for — retribution!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.title_en: Elemental Burst: I (Red Dead of Night Outfit)
items.text: 在此——清算！
items.text_en: Flames, purge!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.title_en: Elemental Burst: II (Red Dead of Night Outfit)
items.text: 烈焰——燃毁！
items.text_en: Lay waste to the wicked!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.title_en: Elemental Burst: III (Red Dead of Night Outfit)
items.text: 破晓——将至！
items.text_en: Dawn, break forth!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 哼，就当是聚沙成塔。
items.text_en: Hmph, better than nothing.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 还不赖。
items.text_en: I suppose this will do.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 一点一滴地积累吧。
items.text_en: We'll need more where that came from.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 这点程度…
items.text_en: Is that all you've got?

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 可恶…
items.text_en: Darn you!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 你会付出代价。
items.text_en: You will pay for that!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: …当心点。
items.text_en: Careful!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 状态不好就去休息。
items.text_en: Don't burn yourself out! Retreat!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 计划…出错了吗…
items.text_en: Where did I go wrong...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 败者…没有借口…
items.text_en: There can be no excuse... for defeat...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 要熄灭了吗…
items.text_en: My flame... has been... extinguished...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 可恶。
items.text_en: Urgh!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 走吧。
items.text_en: Let's go.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 任务的目标是…
items.text_en: What's our objective?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 利落地解决吧。
items.text_en: Let's finish this, swiftly.
